question: The birth anniversary of ______ was observed as ‘Rashtriya Ekta Diwas’ (National Unity Day) on 31st October 2020.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**__.

__
 
• The **birth anniversary** of** Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel **was observed as ‘**Rashtriya Ekta Divas** (National Unity Day) on **31****st**** October 2020**.
